en.title: Two growths in the roof of the mouth

flap: tissue from elsewhere in the body

sentences.text: These models show two growths in the roof of the mouth.
This is the most common growth of a spit gland here that is not cancer.
The surgeon takes it out with the lining over it. The teeth and bone most often stay.
This is a slow cancer that creeps along nerves.
So the surgery goes further back and higher up, and takes some bone and teeth.
Here the gap is closed with tissue moved from elsewhere in the body.
A plate with teeth is another choice. It depends on the gap and what you prefer.
